senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be blown up,] to swell, rise; to be haughty, elated, heedless.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 9b:6">Ned. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ עלי יצרי</he> my evil inclination rose within me (in pride of my beauty); <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 22:1">Sifré Num. 22</cite> <he>פ׳ לבי עלי</he>. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 9; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:4">Gen. R. s. 98</cite>; s. 99 (ref. to <he>פּ֗ח̇ו̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:4">Gen. XLIX, 4</cite>) <he>פָּ֗חַזְתָּ ח̇טאת ז̇נית</he> thou wast overweening, didst sin, didst fornicate.
